name: D. O. Sweet
role: Settler and drayman; candidate for Billings County surveyor
bio: D. O. "Dave" Sweet and his wife came to Medora from Forsythe, Mont., in September 1884, and by January 1885 they were at Buffalo Creek station on the stage line. In June 1885 they moved to Belfield to stay, but they returned in July and took the house vacated by Rassie Deffebach. In spring 1886 he was on the Billings County ticket for county surveyor, and in May he advertised draying.
